Proposed MAP (summary):
- Week 0 (Nov 16-20): Technical deep-dive + gap checklist (Redwood SEs + Acme infra) — owner: Acme/Redwood (joint)
- Week 1 (Nov 23-27): Performance eval + cost modeling using ACME sample workload — owner: Redwood (SE), Acme (data access)
- Week 2 (Nov 30-Dec 4): Legal & Procurement terms review + commercial term sheet — owner: Acme procurement / Redwood sales
- EB Meeting (final approval): pick one 90-min slot Dec 7, Dec 8, or Dec 9 — attendees: CTO, VP Product, Head of Procurement, Redwood VP Sales, Redwood Eng exec
- Post-EB (Dec 10-14): DocuSign and kickoff plan — owner: procurement / Redwood ops

EB meeting cadence options:
- Option A (preferred): Single final EB (90 min) with a 1-week prep packet (reports + short exec summary).
- Option B: Two short EB-style syncs (30 min each): decision pre-read + live Q&A, then final approval.

Action items for us now:
1) I'll circulate the MAP workbook with owners and dates — please confirm owners for the legal and data access rows.
2) Karthik will propose the exact Redwood execs for the EB. 
3) Marissa — can you confirm our VP-level availability on Dec 7/8/9?

If that timeline works I’ll lock the EB slot as soon as we have confirmed attendee availability.

Cheers,
Irene
